categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Jingyi Automation Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor-specific equipment. Its main product lines include semiconductor dedicated temperature control equipment (Chiller), semiconductor dedicated process exhaust gas treatment equipment (Local Scrubber), and wafer handling equipment (Sorter). These products serve critical steps in integrated circuit manufacturing, including logic chips and 3DNAND storage chips production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has independently developed core technologies such as advanced refrigeration control, precise temperature control, and energy-saving technologies for temperature control equipment. It also innovates in low-temperature plasma exhaust gas treatment, corrosion-resistant sealing materials, and combustion technologies for exhaust gas processing. For wafer handling, it has proprietary technologies including automatic centering algorithms, wafer flipping, and micro-contact transmission. The production process involves rigorous R&D phases, prototyping, client validation, and controlled manufacturing with some assembly outsourced under strict quality supervision.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic integrated circuit manufacturers such as Yangtze Memory Technologies, Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC), Hua Hong Group, Guangzhou Yuexin, and Changxin. The company serves the semiconductor manufacturing industry, focusing on logic and storage chip production lines, and has begun expanding into the broader semiconductor and display panel sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within mainland China, with its headquarters in Beijing and a production base in Anhui province. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Japan (BAEC JAPAN) focused on sales, technical support, and material procurement. The company’s products are mainly deployed in Chinese semiconductor fabs but also have international relevance through its Japanese subsidiary.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Jingyi Automation Equipment Co., Ltd. operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in manufacturing semiconductor production equipment. It supplies critical manufacturing tools to downstream semiconductor fabrication plants (fabs). The company manages procurement of core components from suppliers and controls key assembly and testing processes, with some assembly outsourced under supervision.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes independent innovation and continuous R&D investment, focusing on advancing semiconductor temperature control, exhaust gas treatment, and wafer handling technologies. Strategic R&D projects target ultra-low temperature control, multi-channel and energy-efficient equipment, intelligent monitoring systems, and modular product designs. It collaborates with academic institutions for foundational research and aims to maintain international advanced technology levels while expanding product applications in emerging semiconductor and related industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor-specific equipment, including temperature control units, exhaust gas treatment systems, and wafer handling machines. The company employs a direct sales model, engaging customers via negotiations and tenders, and also provides after-sales services such as installation, maintenance, and technical support. Revenue streams include product sales and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international semiconductor equipment giants that dominate the global market, especially in wafer handling and exhaust gas treatment segments. It has successfully broken foreign monopolies in temperature control and exhaust gas treatment equipment within China, positioning itself as a leading domestic supplier with technology at par with international standards. The company faces competition from both established global players and emerging domestic firms but leverages its core technologies and customer relationships to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, representing a 38.28% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 152.9 million, up 28.35%. Total assets grew by 41.38% to RMB 4.04 billion, and net assets increased by 7.27% to RMB 2.07 billion. The company has shown strong growth driven by expanding market demand and successful new customer acquisition, with R&D expenses accounting for over 9% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers domestically developed semiconductor equipment that replaces imported products, providing high precision, energy efficiency, and customization to meet diverse customer needs in advanced chip manufacturing processes. Its products feature industry-leading temperature control accuracy, advanced exhaust gas treatment technologies, and intelligent wafer handling capabilities. The company emphasizes reliable product quality, strong after-sales service with localized support teams, and continuous innovation to maintain technological leadership and customer trust.
